verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet operations and data platform, so simulation-based synthetic data generation and reinforcement learning is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only telemetry ingestion, teleoperation, analytics, commands and fleet orchestration. Nothing documents a simulator, synthetic data generation, or RL training at scale.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate synthetic training data and run reinforcement learning at scale in simulation
